IDs are local worksheet references, not EMMA IDs. Body and appendix assertions remain separate. Objective-to-table-row grouping is analyst mapping by the named measure.

objectives.name: Floodplain forest diversity
objectives.source_text_normalized: Enhance and restore areal coverage and diversity of forest stands and habitat and increase diversity of bottomland hardwood forest, as measured in forested acres suitable to support hard-mast species and structure, age, and species composition.

objectives.name: Aquatic diversity
objectives.source_text_normalized: Increase year-round aquatic habitat diversity, as measured by acres and limnophilic native fish use of overwintering habitat, as this habitat is the most limiting of seasonal habitats.

objectives.name: Island restoration and protection
objectives.source_text_normalized: Restore 50% of island acreage and topography lost since the 1950s and protect from erosion within the Project area, as measured by acres.

objectives.name: Backwater protection and interior wetland enhancement
objectives.source_text_normalized: Protect existing backwater habitat from sediment deposition and enhance backwater and interior wetland areas, as measured by acres of backwater and survivability of scrub-shrub/pollinator habitat.
